title: Registered Meta-Model Entry
description: One entry of the live register (06-ecosystem/registry/entries/*.yaml). Registration is discovery, not storage: an entry references an authoritative source. Fields mirror Registered-Meta-Models sections 4 and 5.

id.description: Stable registry identifier, dot-separated, publisher-prefixed (e.g. vercy.world-models). Never reused.

publisher.description: Who publishes the model (project or organization).

owner.description: The sovereign Owner of the model. Registration does not transfer ownership.

steward.description: The accountable human or team for freshness, quality and security.

version.description: Current version of the model (semver or the model's own scheme).

kind.description: Registry scope class per Registered-Meta-Models section 2. registry registers a whole registry of Meta-Models, read through the Registry Federation Interface (ECO-014).

status.description: Lifecycle per the Open Registration Policy (ECO-013) section 9; suspended is set by the register, never by the registrant.

access.description: public: source openly reachable. restricted: readable only with the Owner's permission; source coordinates may be omitted.

source.description: The authoritative source (the master, per ARCH-018). Required when access is public.

path.description: Path inside the repository if the model is not at the root.

ref.description: Pinned branch, tag or commit for reproducible download.

arch017.description: Carries the ARCH-017 traversal contract (BOOTSTRAP.md + manifest).

arch019.description: Carries the ARCH-019 DatasetBinding contract for structure, representation, carrier, access, traversal and coverage.

purpose.description: One or two sentences: what the model is for.

dependencies.description: Registry ids of models this one builds on.

imports.description: External standards imported (names as in external-models.csv).

fingerprint.description: Self-declared Semantic Fingerprint of the registered version.

proof.description: Proof of control of the registered source (ECO-013 section 6, ECO-014 I3). Required for registrations made under the Open Registration Policy.

domain.description: For method domain: the domain serving /.well-known/vercy-verification.txt.

path.description: For method repository: the path of the token file inside source.repository at source.ref.

did.description: For method did: the Decentralized Identifier whose key signs the submission.

harvest.description: For kind registry: where and how often the register reads the publisher's registry (ECO-014 I2, I5).

catalogue.description: Optional catalogue of entries, one entry per line (JSONL), for large registries.

cadence.description: ISO 8601 duration between harvests, from PT1H to P30D.

card_supplement.description: Optional card supplement that fills card sections the model does not carry; it never edits the registered source.
